title: 1o0elfe
Nahrawan
hook: After the Arbitration a group parted from Imam Ali. The clash took place at Nahrawan.
scenes.0.text: When the mushafs were hung on spears at Siffin, arbitration was discussed. A group from **Imam Ali**'s army rejected it. "Judgment belongs to God alone," they said. These are called the Kharijites. Imam Ali said, "The word is true, but falsehood is meant by it." This sentence also stands in the Siffin account.
scenes.0.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.1.text: The Kharijites killed Abdullah b. Khabbab and his pregnant wife. **Imam Ali** turned the army from the campaign against Mu'awiya to Nahrawan. First there was talk. Then there was fighting. The number of dead varies by report. The trick on the spear had split Imam Ali's own ranks as well. Nahrawan is the step after Siffin.
scenes.1.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
sunni.0.says: The Kharijites' separation and the clash at Nahrawan are mentioned together with Siffin. No new page was opened in this round.
shia.0.says: That Imam Ali said "the word is true, falsehood is meant" and that there was then fighting at Nahrawan is also written in the Siffin scene in the app. A separate page was not opened.
questions.0: How did the Arbitration split Imam Ali's ranks? Where does Nahrawan stand in this division?
summary: After the Arbitration the Kharijites separated. They killed Abdullah b. Khabbab and his pregnant wife. Imam Ali turned the army to Nahrawan. The event is read in the wake of Siffin.
notes.0: After the Arbitration a group parted from Imam Ali.
notes.1: There was fighting at Nahrawan. The detail is read in the wake of Siffin.
